# Interpreter option sets for codspeed-diagnose: one line per set, a name followed by the options
# given to the interpreter before the harness. Run in the order listed (or the order given with
# --variants). Nothing measured with these is reported to CodSpeed.
#
# A set with --vm.XX:+PrintGC also runs with -u and live iteration reports, so that every GC line in
# the output comes after the iteration lines that precede it in time; the GC lines between two
# iteration lines belong to the second iteration. The logger python.capi.PythonCextBuiltins at
# level CONFIG prints one line each time a native allocation crosses the native memory limit
# (--python.InitialNativeMemory), after which GraalPy forces up to seven full collections.
# "default" is run exactly as the benchmark job runs, without any of this.
#
# name           options
gc-log           --vm.XX:+PrintGC --log.python.capi.PythonCextBuiltins.level=CONFIG
no-explicit-gc   --vm.XX:+DisableExplicitGC --vm.XX:+PrintGC --log.python.capi.PythonCextBuiltins.level=CONFIG
no-bg-task       --experimental-options --python.BackgroundGCTask=false --vm.XX:+PrintGC --log.python.capi.PythonCextBuiltins.level=CONFIG
default
native-8g        --experimental-options --python.BackgroundGCTask=false --python.InitialNativeMemory=8589934592 --vm.XX:+PrintGC --log.python.capi.PythonCextBuiltins.level=CONFIG
# The serial GC's default policy (Adaptive2) only takes a maximum young generation size; the policy
# BySpaceAndTime keeps the young generation at that size. Changes the policy and the size together.
young-1g         --experimental-options --python.BackgroundGCTask=false --vm.XX:InitialCollectionPolicy=BySpaceAndTime --vm.Xmn1g --vm.XX:+PrintGC --log.python.capi.PythonCextBuiltins.level=CONFIG
